_approach: Log-drum-led build: the tomLow+congaLow pair from the log-drum groove thickens from a single answering hit per bar to a rolling, density-climbing figure with velocity pushed toward 127, imitating the pitched log drum's own build-up habit, while the shaker drops to almost nothing so the log drum reads as the lead into the drop. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
